title: On Hesitating for a moment at the door
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：hesitate　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hesitate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the trader ① hesitated for a moment at the door in public, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the trader ② hesitates for a moment at the door in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hesitate for a moment at the door at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hesitated for a moment at the door before — a line in the list for October 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hesitating for a moment at the door in public, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hesitate to tell the whole truth in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hesitate to tell the whole truth at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new partner from the next market ⑧ hesitates to tell the whole truth in public every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ hesitated for a moment at the door again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hesitate for a moment at the door, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the market remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the market forgets, somebody hesitates for a moment at the door in silence again and somebody must hesitate for a moment at the door in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 迟疑（一般过去式 hesitated for a moment at the door：1993 年货商头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 迟疑（一般现在 hesitates for a moment at the door：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 迟疑（不定式 to hesitate for a moment at the door：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 迟疑（过去完成时 had hesitated for a moment at the door：1987 年十月的货单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 迟疑（动名词 hesitating for a moment at the door 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 踌躇（hesitate to tell the whole truth：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去踌躇把全部实情说出来）
G. v. 踌躇（hesitate to tell the whole truth：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 迟疑（后段两处：新来的伙计照例 hesitates to tell the whole truth，而母亲又一次 hesitated for a moment at the door）

answers.why: hesitate 意为“迟疑”，1993 年货商当着众人面迟疑在门口迟疑了一下，那是集市里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 hesitated。
hesitate 意为“迟疑”，自那以后货商一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 hesitates。
hesitate 意为“迟疑”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯迟疑在门口迟疑了一下”，此处为不定式 to hesitate for a moment at the door。
hesitate 意为“迟疑”，货单里 十月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人迟疑过，故用过去完成时 had hesitated。
hesitate 意为“迟疑”，货商说“迟疑在门口迟疑了一下这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 hesitating for a moment at the door 作主语。
hesitate 意为“踌躇”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去踌躇把全部实情说出来”，should ever 之后用原形 hesitate to tell the whole truth。
hesitate 意为“踌躇”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻踌躇把全部实情说出来（hesitate to tell the whole truth at once），以后再也不要提起。
hesitate 意为“迟疑”，新来的伙计每个星期都照例踌躇把全部实情说出来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 hesitates。
hesitate 意为“迟疑”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面迟疑在门口迟疑了一下，用一般过去式 hesitated 叙述。
hesitate 意为“迟疑”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要迟疑在门口迟疑了一下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和集市记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，货商当着众人面迟疑在门口迟疑了一下；集市里每一个伙计都说这是头一回。（hesitated for a moment at the door）
多年以后，货商仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（hesitates for a moment at the door）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯迟疑在门口迟疑了一下这件事本身。（to hesitate for a moment at the door）
早在 1987 年就有人迟疑在门口迟疑了一下，十月那天货单上的一行字就是证据。（had hesitated for a moment at the door）
货商说过，当着众人面迟疑在门口迟疑了一下这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（hesitating for a moment at the door 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻踌躇把全部实情说出来，以后再也不要提起。（hesitate to tell the whole truth，祈使句）
answers: In 1993 the trader hesitated for a moment at the door in public, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the trader still hesitates for a moment at the door in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to hesitate for a moment at the door at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had hesitated for a moment at the door long before 2000, and the line in the list for October proves it.
Hesitating for a moment at the door in public, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Hesitate to tell the whole truth at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hesitate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the trader hesitated for a moment at the door in public, and nobody in the market forgot it.
Even now the trader hesitates for a moment at the door in silence whenever the market asks.
Hesitating for a moment at the door in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hesitate to tell the whole truth in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new partner from the next market hesitates to tell the whole truth in public every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother hesitated for a moment at the door again, and the market remembered that half.
